title: Pirate Adventure Cruise on Tampa Bay
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
Join the swashbuckling fun aboard Tampa’s unique pirate ship, The Lost Pearl. This family-friendly adventure cruise offers an engaging mix of music, games, and lively dancing, all while soaking in the stunning sights of Tampa Bay. With a full bar onboard, adults can enjoy refreshing beverages as kids explore their inner pirates. This cruise promises an unforgettable experience for families and pirate enthusiasts alike, making it a perfect outing for everyone. 

- Enjoy a family-friendly pirate adventure on The Lost Pearl
- Participate in games, water cannon battles, and dancing
- Scenic views of Tampa Bay during the cruise
- Full bar for adults, soda and water available for kids.
